facts.value: Courses in biomedical sciences prepare students for careers in the field by teaching them about the structure and functions of living organisms, such as cell organisation and biological information transmission. Through hands-on lab training, data analysis, and learning how to use math and statistics to interpret biomedical data, they gain fundamental research skills.
facts.programme_association: Biomedical Engineering - BE or ME | University of Limerick

facts.value: Students learn how to gather information from various sources to make well-informed decisions regarding biological matters, design and carry out scientific experiments, and discuss ethical concerns such as responsible research techniques.
facts.programme_association: Biomedical Engineering - BE or ME | University of Limerick

facts.value: Usually, they work behind the scenes in labs, but some may interact with patients in research studies.

facts.value: Strong analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail are essential for a biomedical scientist.
